people.name: Roberto Rino Magliola
people.field: European hermeneutics and deconstruction, comparative philosophy, and inter-religious dialogue

relations.subject: Roberto Rino Magliola
relations.evidence: Magliola received his doctorate in 1970 from Princeton University in comparative literature, with a dissertation in phenomenology and hermeneutics.

relations.subject: Roberto Rino Magliola
relations.evidence: He took up a position at Purdue University in 1969, and was promoted to professor in 1981.

relations.subject: Roberto Rino Magliola
relations.evidence: From 1983 to 1984, Magliola taught and researched at Tamkang University in Taiwan while on sabbatical from Purdue.

relations.subject: Roberto Rino Magliola
relations.role: professor of philosophy and religious studies
relations.evidence: In 1985, Magliola moved to Asia where he held posts in the interfaith graduate school of philosophy and religions at Assumption University (Thailand), where he was the professor of philosophy and religious studies

relations.subject: Roberto Rino Magliola
relations.evidence: at the National Taiwan University, where he held a distinguished chair in the graduate school of liberal arts.

relations.subject: Roberto Rino Magliola
relations.evidence: Magliola was a seminar associate (2002–2011) of the seminar in Buddhist studies at Columbia University
